purpose: A checkout service that accepts orders over HTTP and completes payment authorisation asynchronously.

essential_concepts.name: Two processes, one database
essential_concepts.description: The API and the worker are separate binaries that coordinate only through the shared database, not through direct calls.

essential_concepts.name: Order lifecycle
essential_concepts.description: An order is created pending and later becomes authorized or failed. Nothing else moves it between states.

important_components.name: HTTP API (cmd/api)
important_components.description: Serves POST /orders and returns 202 once the order is recorded.

important_components.name: OrderService
important_components.description: Writes the order and its outbox entry in one transaction.

important_components.name: Outbox store
important_components.description: Holds pending completion work and mediates claiming between workers.

important_components.name: Completion worker (cmd/worker)
important_components.description: Polls the outbox, calls the payments provider and records the outcome.

important_components.name: Payments client
important_components.description: The only outbound integration, calling an external provider over HTTP.

important_components.name: Schema (migrations)
important_components.description: orders and order_outbox define the persisted state.

important_relationships.name: API writes, worker reads
important_relationships.description: The outbox table is the handoff point between the two processes.

important_relationships.name: Worker to payments provider
important_relationships.description: The only place an external call is made.

important_flows.name: Order acceptance
important_flows.description: POST /orders decodes the request, writes order and outbox rows transactionally, and returns 202.

important_flows.name: Order completion
important_flows.description: The worker ticks, claims up to 20 entries, authorises each and sets the order status, returning transport failures to pending.

supporting_context.name: Failure handling
supporting_context.description: A declined payment is final; a transport error leaves the entry pending for the next tick.
